explication: Gatsby is a React framework for building content-rich sites and apps. The documented workflow is to load content from sources, query it through a uniform GraphQL interface, create pages, render them with a mix of static, deferred, or server-side strategies, and deploy the resulting site. The graph also shows job execution, remote-image handling, and adapter output as internal layers. README capabilities guide the high-level flow; sampled source is limited, so links to unsampled subsystems are omitted or kept at documented boundaries.
